risks.risk: Whether it powers on and is fully functional (scanner, copier, printer engine, and finishing/duplex). Photos do not show a test print or powered status.
risks.proof: A short video clip of the machine powering on, showing the home screen, and printing a single color page (with output visible).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not fully tested / worst-case not working until proven.

risks.risk: Toner/consumables condition (toner levels, drum/transfer belt life, waste toner container status). Photos do not show toner/drum condition.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of toner cartridges (all colors), waste toner container, and any consumable counters/labels; plus a test page showing solid color output.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as needing consumables/toner replacement for reliable output.

risks.risk: Paper path issues or jams (common on used MFPs). No evidence of successful feeding/duplex.
risks.proof: Video of feeding from the main tray and completing a duplex print without jams.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as requiring troubleshooting for paper handling.

risks.risk: Network/driver readiness (Ethernet/Wi‑Fi, print queue, and correct drivers). Not verifiable from photos.
risks.proof: Screenshot of network settings (IP address) and a successful print from a laptop/PC (showing the job completed).

risks.risk: Missing parts/accessories (e.g., bypass tray, finisher, stapler, or specific options). Photos may not show all modules.
risks.proof: Photo of the full unit from all sides showing installed options, plus a list of included accessories.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as base unit only (no extra options assumed).

proof_requests: Power-on video + home screen close-up (showing no error codes).
Print a single color test page (output visible) and show the job finishing successfully.
Duplex test (if supported) and a short jam-free feeding video.
Close-ups of toner cartridges (all colors) and waste toner container.
Network settings screenshot (IP) and a completed print from a laptop/PC.
response.reason: The model appears readable as Konica Minolta bizhub PRO C754e from the photo, but there is no powered-on/test evidence. For a high-value MFP, functionality, consumable condition, and options are the key price drivers and cannot be confirmed remotely from this single image.
